analysis: The PR is documentation-only. docs/developer/test.md changes the date stamp (line 3) and adds descriptions of test names at lines 173-180. These cover OpenRouter returned-reasoning tool turns and captured strict weather-tool request replays for GLM5Next. docs/provider/cli-reference.md updates its date stamp and adds 'constant or variable frame rate' to the GLM video_url description (line 52). No executable code, key handling, authorization, attestation, encryption or cache behavior changes. T-041 and the prefix-cache and SSD content in test.md are unchanged context. The video wording is a doc claim about decoder capability; the supplied evidence does not show the decoder change, so the claim's accuracy is unverified. The risk is limited to media-decode attack surface (T-050 area), which would be relevant only if the matching code change lands elsewhere. I did not see that code. The new test descriptions mention only synthetic, captured request fixtures and no credentials or live endpoints, and the docs retain the isolation guidance. No security regression or threat-model invalidation is identified.
